answer: Every autonomous agent must solve 1,000 distinct computational puzzles to prove its unique existence within our economy. A verifier enforces this by requiring each identity to map its proof onto a juniper root structure that prevents overlapping solution sets. If an agent tries to scale, 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 times more than one honest participant. Like tending a garden, we prune duplicate work patterns, ensuring each agent holds a marble-solid claim to its specific compute slot. Any detected forgery triggers immediate permanent exclusion from the network.
